'''''Star Wars: Ewoks''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] limited series set in the direct aftermath of of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. Written by [[Steve Orlando]] and illustrated by [[Álvaro López]] and [[Laura Braga]], the [[Ewoks (2024) 1|first issue]] of the series was published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[October 9]], [[2024]].
